tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Terminal background (Alacritty colors.primary.background). The ground for every screen, and the preview page's card fill.

tokens.name: bg-page
tokens.usage: Preview page ground behind the terminal cards (previews/monitor-drafts.html --bg).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Default foreground (ESC[39m, TEXT). Readings, process names, panel titles in bold. 10.5:1 on bg.

tokens.name: text-bright
tokens.usage: Alacritty bright_foreground and selection text. Not used by the monitor itself.

tokens.name: text-faint
tokens.usage: Alacritty dim_foreground and hint end label. Not used by the monitor itself.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Alacritty selection background, with text-bright on top.

tokens.name: search-match
tokens.usage: Alacritty search match fill, with bg as text.

tokens.name: ansi-black
tokens.usage: ANSI 0. Preview page hairlines and the selected segment fill. 1.25:1 on bg, so it separates cards but carries no meaning on its own.

tokens.name: ansi-red
tokens.usage: ANSI 1 (ESC[31m). Bound to level-high.

tokens.name: ansi-green
tokens.usage: ANSI 2 (ESC[32m). Bound to level-low.

tokens.name: ansi-yellow
tokens.usage: ANSI 3 (ESC[33m). Your Alacritty palette puts a lilac in the yellow slot, so ESC[33m renders lilac. Bound to level-mid and accent.

tokens.name: ansi-blue
tokens.usage: ANSI 4 (ESC[34m). Bound to series-gpu.

tokens.name: ansi-magenta
tokens.usage: ANSI 5 (ESC[35m). Your palette puts amber in the magenta slot, so ESC[35m renders amber. Bound to series-net.

tokens.name: ansi-cyan
tokens.usage: ANSI 6 (ESC[36m). Bound to series-power.

tokens.name: ansi-white
tokens.usage: ANSI 7. Not used by the monitor.

tokens.name: ansi-bright-black
tokens.usage: ANSI 8 (ESC[90m). Bound to dim. 5.5:1 on bg.

tokens.name: ansi-bright-red
tokens.usage: ANSI 9. Not used by the monitor.

tokens.name: ansi-bright-green
tokens.usage: ANSI 10. Not used by the monitor.

tokens.name: ansi-bright-yellow
tokens.usage: ANSI 11 (lilac). Not used by the monitor.

tokens.name: ansi-bright-blue
tokens.usage: ANSI 12. Not used by the monitor.

tokens.name: ansi-bright-magenta
tokens.usage: ANSI 13 (amber). Not used by the monitor.

tokens.name: ansi-bright-cyan
tokens.usage: ANSI 14. Not used by the monitor.

tokens.name: ansi-bright-white
tokens.usage: ANSI 15. Same value as text-bright.

tokens.name: dim
tokens.usage: DIM and FR in bin/monitor. Box frames, labels, units, separators, the off cells of a bar, the clock, and the dash shown before data arrives.

tokens.name: level-low
tokens.usage: LOW: a percentage under 50. Bars, core readings, the lower rows of an unfixed braille graph, and process CPU% below 50.

tokens.name: level-mid
tokens.usage: MID: 50 to 79 percent. Also the fixed colour of the mem tile sparkline and the 'starting mactop…' status.

tokens.name: level-high
tokens.usage: HIGH: 80 percent and up. Also the fixed colour of the temp tile sparkline.

tokens.name: series-gpu
tokens.usage: GPU: the gpu tile, gpu graph and the GPU ms/s process column.

tokens.name: series-power
tokens.usage: POWER: the power tile and graph, and the cloudflare upload (↑) tile and sparkline.

tokens.name: series-net
tokens.usage: NET: cloudflare download (↓) tile, headline speeds and download sparkline.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Alacritty cursor and focused search match; the preview page's draft number. Never a data colour outside level-mid.

styles.name: cell
styles.usage: Every character on a monitor screen. Alacritty runs it at size 11; 11.5px/1.18 is the rendered-preview equivalent. One size only: hierarchy comes from weight and colour.

styles.name: cell-bold
styles.usage: TITLE (ESC[1m): box titles, headline values in tile and box headers, the machine name, the process table header row.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: The one h1 on a preview page.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Draft name in a card header.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: a row of heavy KPI tiles, graphs under, processes last
styles.usage: Intro and card descriptions, in dim.

styles.name: mono-label
styles.usage: Run commands, segmented toggle labels and card footers (terminal size), in dim.

tokens.name: window-pad-x
tokens.usage: Alacritty window padding, left and right.

tokens.name: window-pad-y
tokens.usage: Alacritty window padding, top and bottom.

tokens.name: term-pad-y
tokens.usage: Preview page: vertical padding around a rendered screen.

tokens.name: term-pad-x
tokens.usage: Preview page: horizontal padding around a rendered screen.

tokens.name: card-pad-x
tokens.usage: Preview page: card header and footer side padding (header 14px tall padding).

tokens.name: page-pad-y
tokens.usage: Preview page: top and bottom padding; 16px sides.

tokens.name: radius-term
tokens.usage: Terminal frames have no CSS radius. Corners are box-drawing characters: heavy ┏ in the adopted draft, rounded ╭ in drafts 01, 04, 06 and 10.

tokens.name: radius-seg
tokens.usage: Preview page segmented toggle (live / before data).

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Preview page draft card.

grid.note: Terminal layout is counted in character cells, not pixels.

tokens.name: cell-xpad
tokens.usage: XPAD: blank column at each side of the screen.

tokens.name: cell-gap
tokens.usage: hjoin gap between side-by-side boxes and tiles.

tokens.name: cell-inset
tokens.usage: Box inner width is width minus 4: one frame column and one space on each side.

tokens.name: core-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between core meters on one row of the cores panel.

tokens.name: rule-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between columns when frames are rule-only (draft 05), and between the stats and run bars in draft 08.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Width of the all-numbers sidebar in draft 06.

tokens.name: stat-label
tokens.usage: Label width in a StatRow (draft 06). Draft 09's compact rows use 6.

tokens.name: tile-rows
tokens.usage: Tile height in rows: top frame, value, sparkline, bottom frame.

tokens.name: history
tokens.usage: HIST: samples kept per series (one per second from mactop).
